text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-i-t-i-a-t-e-d t-h-e p-r-o-c-e-s-s t-o s-e-l-l c-a-r-b-o-n c-r-e-d-i-t-s f-r-o-m n-o-n-e-x-i-s-t-e-n-t r-e-f-o-r-e-s-t-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-j-e-c-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a b-e-h-i-n-d a s-a-l-e-s p-l-a-n d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-c-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d g-p-s p-l-o-t d-a-t-a f-o-r f-i-c-t-i-t-i-o-n a-l p-l-a-n-t-i-n-g s-i-t-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a b-e-h-i-n-d s-y-n-t-h-e-t-i-c c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e f-i-l-e-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l s-i-t-e v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r g-e-n-e-r-a-t-e-d f-a-l-s-e s-a-t-e-l-l-i-t-e i-m-a-g-e-r-y a-s p-r-o-o-f o-f r-e-f-o-r-e-s-t-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a b-e-h-i-n-d m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-e-d r-e-m-o-t-e s-e-n-s-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-m-a-g-e r-e-g-i-s-t-r-a-t-i-o-n a-u-d-i-t.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d b-o-g-u-s v-e-r-i-f-i-e-r r-e-p-o-r-t-s t-o a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-e t-h-e f-i-c-t-i-t-i-o-n p-r-o-j-e-c-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a b-e-h-i-n-d f-o-r-g-e-d c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t t-h-i-r-d p-a-r-t-y r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-v-e-l-o-p-e-d a c-l-i-e-n-t f-a-c-i-n-g n-a-r-r-a-t-i-v-e d-e-s-i-g-n-e-d t-o b-y-p-a-s-s d-u-e d-i-l-i-g-e-n-c-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a b-e-h-i-n-d a m-i-s-l-e-a-d-i-n-g s-a-l-e-s p-r-e-s-e-n-t-a-t-i-o-n w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-a-n-d-o-m b-u-y-e-r i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l.
